description: This file defines a terminal-based test reporter for Playwright, including classes and functions for formatting test results, errors, and summaries, as well as managing output to terminal or files.

classes.name: TerminalReporter
classes.description: A class implementing a terminal-based test reporter for Playwright, handling test result formatting, output, and summaries.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed failure message for a test, including attachments and error details.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats a test error into a detailed message with stack trace and snippets.

methods.name: formatResultErrors
methods.description: Formats errors from a test result for display.

methods.name: markErrorsAsReported
methods.description: Marks errors in a test result as reported to avoid duplicate reporting.

methods.name: formatResultFailure
methods.description: Creates an array of ErrorDetails for each error in a test result, including special messages for expected failures and interruptions.

methods.name: relativeFilePath
methods.description: Returns a relative file path based on the screen's resolveFiles setting.

methods.name: relativeTestPath
methods.description: Returns a relative path to the test's file.

methods.name: stepSuffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix string for test steps.

methods.name: formatTestTitle
methods.description: Formats a test's title with location, project, and tags.

methods.name: formatTestHeader
methods.description: Formats a header line for a test, optionally including error step path.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Creates a separator line for terminal output.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Indents lines with a specified prefix.

methods.name: prepareErrorStack
methods.description: Parses and prepares an error stack trace.

methods.name: characterWidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a character.

methods.name: stringWidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string.

methods.name: suffixOfWidth
methods.description: Returns a suffix of a string fitting within a specified width.

methods.name: fitToWidth
methods.description: Truncates a line to fit within a specified width, adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: resolveOutputFile
methods.description: Resolves the output file path for a reporter based on environment variables and options.
